children: Moxy Mumbai Andheri West has appointed Akshay Pethkar as Loss & Prevention Manager, bringing over 12 years of experience across hospitality, aviation and maritime security operations.

In his new role, Akshay will oversee the property’s security and safety operations, focusing on guest and associate safety, emergency preparedness, risk management, fire safety compliance, crisis management and loss prevention. He will also strengthen security protocols and ensure adherence to safety standards and operational SOPs.

Akshay joins Moxy Mumbai Andheri West from Vivanta, Thane, where he served as Security & Safety Manager and led hotel security and safety operations. Prior to this, he spent over seven years with President IHCL SeleQtions, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai, managing hotel security operations, loss prevention, emergency preparedness and VVIP movement coordination.
His earlier experience includes security roles with Costa Cruises and SpiceJet Ltd., giving him exposure to maritime, aviation and hospitality security environments.
Akshay holds a Bachelor of Computer Applications from Yashwantrao Chavan Maharashtra Open University.
